## Summary
Describe the concrete change and why it is needed.

## Validation
- [ ] Relevant build or tests were run, or the reason they were not is stated.
- [ ] Configuration and outputs are reproducible where applicable.
- [ ] Claims distinguish implemented behavior from planned work.
- [ ] No experimental result is presented without an executed run and provenance.
- [ ] Documentation and limitations were updated where needed.

## Research impact
Does this change alter model semantics, intervention meaning, metrics, or scientific claims? If yes, describe the change and its consequences.
